title: Supersymmetric Yang-Mills theories with several times reduce to ten dimensions: paper and verification code

creators.name: Bhattacharjee, Deep
creators.affiliation: Formerly, Electro-Gravitational Space Propulsion Laboratory (EGSPL), Bhubaneswar, India; formerly, University of Calcutta, Kolkata, India

description: LaTeX source, PDF and verification code for the paper Supersymmetric Yang-Mills theories with several times reduce to ten dimensions. The paper proves that a supersymmetric Yang-Mills theory built on k mutually orthogonal null vectors in signature (s,t), in the manner of Nishino's theories in (9+m)+(1+m), satisfies k ≤ min(s,t), s+t-2k ∈ {2,10} and s-t ∈ {8,0,-8}. There is therefore no such theory in (9+8n)+1, (10+8n)+2, (11+8n)+3 or (12+8n)+4 for n ≥ 1, including 27+3 and 19+3. In (9+8n)+1 with n ≥ 1 every massless supermultiplet without tensor charges has at least 2^(2^(2+4n)) states, so a unitary theory with no tensor charges on its massless states has no massless vector multiplet. The Python programs check the statements in explicit gamma matrices (34 checks) and draw the figures; no proof in the paper depends on them.
